verse: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
story: The risen Jesus gave His friends one last instruction before He rose out of their sight on the Mount of Olives.

They had asked about the kingdom and about timing. He told them instead about a gift and a job. The Holy Spirit would come on them with power, and they would be His witnesses, beginning at home in Jerusalem, then through Judea and Samaria, and finally to the farthest places on earth. A witness does not invent the story; a witness tells what he has seen and heard of Christ.
You are not asked to be impressive today, only to be truthful about Jesus where you already are.
